text:
anna-frontend: heads-up — metric dashboard is stuttering after the last deploy. Full panel (heatmap + legend) spikes main-thread ~600–800ms on open.

sam-platform: which view? canary or prod?

anna-frontend: Org → Metrics → Full panel. Repro on both; easiest to repro with ~100 series visible.

mike-telemetry: I dug into the stream logs. /internal/metrics-stream payloads jumped ~3x. We started including the entire series_meta object per datapoint in that deploy.

luca-enginfra: example payload please.

mike-telemetry: snippet:
```
{series_id:"svc.billing", ts:1712345678, val:0.42, series_meta:{owner:{team:"billing",emails:["a@x", "b@x"]},desc:"..."}}
```
old schema was id + short label only.

anna-frontend: That explains it — parsing + creating legend nodes for every point is expensive. Frontend assumed compact records.

sam-platform: also we rolled the SVG-only legend renderer (removed canvas fallback) in the same release.

praveen-appsec: AppSec note: embedding contact lists in telemetry is a privacy problem. Need gating.

luca-enginfra: We have telemetry_v2_metadata flag. Propose immediate revert server-side to stop inlining metadata, and flip legend renderer flag back to canvas on canary.

mike-telemetry: Agreed. Plan:
- Quick: flip telemetry_v2_metadata -> OFF on canary
- Quick: legend_svg_renderer -> OFF on canary
- Medium: introduce compact-stream schema + /series-meta lazy endpoint
- Long: consider binary packed stream for charts

anna-frontend: For rendering mitigation I can also throttle label layout and experiment with OffscreenCanvas in a POC (flagged, fallbacks for Safari).

deploy-bot: scheduled feature-flag flips: telemetry_v2_metadata -> OFF on canary at 15:05 UTC; legend_svg_renderer -> OFF on canary at 15:07 UTC.

mike-telemetry: canary flipped. payload sizes back to ~7.5k. telemetry logs look normal.

anna-frontend: Quick local test: canvas legend restores ~120–180ms main-thread time. Good signal.

praveen-appsec: I'll run privacy gating on the compact schema before we reintroduce any richer fields. Legal looped in.

luca-enginfra: Canary stable for 30m. Scheduling prod flips.

deploy-bot: telemetry_v2_metadata -> OFF on prod at 15:45 UTC; legend_svg_renderer -> OFF on prod at 15:47 UTC. Promotion complete.

anna-frontend: Prod smoke: main-thread reduced ~150–200ms on the problematic panel. No client errors surfaced.

mike-telemetry: I'll draft RFC for compact metadata + lazy fetch pattern and include privacy checklist and perf targets.

sam-platform: Thanks. Owners: luca -> rollback + deploy cookbook, anna -> OffscreenCanvas POC (UX-xxxx), mike -> RFC (T-xxxx), praveen -> privacy gating. Keep updates short here and escalate if anything regresses. :thumbsup:
